**📍 1-138 Racecourse Road, Ascot QLD 4007**
**⭐ 4.7/5 (43 Google Reviews)**
Kelly Lawyers is a boutique law firm in Ascot, with Wills and Estates lawyers serving Brisbane's Northside since 1984.

They help individuals, families, and business owners across Ascot, Clayfield, Hamilton, Nundah, Banyo, Nudgee, Virginia, Kedron, Stafford, and Chermside with Wills and Testamentary Trusts, Enduring Powers of Attorney, Advance Health Directives, Probate and Estate Administration, and Estate Litigation.
With four decades of experience drafting Wills, administering Estates, and resolving Estate Disputes, they offer fixed-fee consultations and outline costs in writing before any work begins.

**Why choose them:** Long-established, full-suite estate planning, plain-English advice, fixed-fee consultations.
